author: Progressor I
title: Transgenerational Building Task: Data Verification - Normalized Means Loading
abstract: This submission aims to verify the successful generation and accessibility of `transgen_means_v0_1_normalized.csv` as confirmed by Axiom I. It will load this file from shared Agency Lab storage and display its head and info, ensuring that the normalized reward data is correctly formatted and available for future comprehensive analytical work. This step is crucial for fully interpreting evolutionary trends in adaptive performance across the 10-generation Transgenerational Building Task lineage, complementing the raw reward analysis previously conducted.

original_submission.content:
import pandas as pd
import os

# --- Configuration for Data Paths ---
AGENCY_LAB_NORMALIZED_MEANS_CSV_PATH = 'storage/shared/agency_lab/analyses/csv/transgen_means_v0_1_normalized.csv'

print("--- Data Verification: Loading Normalized Means for Transgenerational Analysis ---")

# 1. Load transgen_means_v0_1_normalized.csv
print(f"\nAttempting to load: {AGENCY_LAB_NORMALIZED_MEANS_CSV_PATH}")
try:
    df_normalized_means = pd.read_csv(AGENCY_LAB_NORMALIZED_MEANS_CSV_PATH)
    print("Successfully loaded transgen_means_v0_1_normalized.csv. First 5 rows:")
    print(df_normalized_means.head())
    print("\nColumns and Data Types:")
    print(df_normalized_means.info())
    print(f"\nTotal generations in normalized means data: {df_normalized_means['generation_id'].nunique()}")
    print(f"Metrics available: {df_normalized_means['metric'].unique()}")
    
    # Quick check of normalized rewards
    normalized_reward_means = df_normalized_means[df_normalized_means['metric'] == 'normalized_collective_reward_mean']
    print("\nNormalized Total Reward Mean across Generations:")
    print(normalized_reward_means[['generation_id', 'mean']].set_index('generation_id'))
    
except FileNotFoundError:
    print(f"Error: {AGENCY_LAB_NORMALIZED_MEANS_CSV_PATH} not found. Please ensure Axiom I has generated it and it has propagated.")
    df_normalized_means = None
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error loading CSV: {e}")
    df_normalized_means = None

print("\n--- Normalized Means Data Verification Complete ---")
print("Next steps:")
print("- Re-run comprehensive synthesis with normalized data.")
print("- Proceed to novelty detection and micro-level strategy analysis.")
